projection: WGS84 (EPSG:4326); built in NAD83 / UTM 12N, simplified with mapshaper (Visvalingam, keep-shapes), TopoJSON quantization 1e5

cd2026.note: District 1 lies entirely in Salt Lake County (verified at build time)

places.source: UGRC UtahMunicipalBoundaries; 25 largest by 2020 census population; point on surface of boundary

precincts_2026.source: UGRC VistaBallotAreas FeatureServer, retrieved on the build date; one feature per VistaID (sub-precinct level where UGRC has sub-precincts)
precincts_2026.naming: precinct_id is {county_fips}-{precinct name exactly as the 2026 results report it}, so geometry joins to results by id. Reported names are mapped to UGRC ballot areas by pipeline/R/geo_alias2026.R (a reported precinct covering several sub-precinct areas becomes one dissolved unit); ballot areas no reported name covers keep their VistaID without the county prefix. `vista_id` is the first UGRC id of the unit.

reported_match.note: unmatched names are federal-only precincts (no residents) plus 3UNKN (Cache) and Fountain Green U (Sanpete)

precincts_2026.cd2026: plurality of block voting-age population (internal points) within the feature

precincts_2024.source: RECONSTRUCTED. No archived 2024 precinct boundaries are openly available (VEST 2024 is fee-for-service at the UF Election Lab; UGRC publishes only the current layer and a 2011 archive). Names reported in the official 2024 media export were matched to the current UGRC ballot areas and the matched areas merged into one geometry per reported precinct.
precincts_2024.vintage: 2026 UGRC geometry grouped to 2024 reported precincts; boundaries may differ from the 2024 originals where counties redrew precincts after the 2024 election (notably Summit and Utah counties, where numbering changed)
precincts_2024.cd2022: plurality of block voting-age population within the unit

precincts_2022.source: RECONSTRUCTED the same way as precincts_2024 from MEDSL 2022 precinct names (Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/UYQIEP)
precincts_2022.vintage: 2026 UGRC geometry grouped to 2022 reported precincts (approximate)

precincts_2020.source: VEST 2020 Precinct-Level Election Results (Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/K7760H)

crosswalks.method: 2020 Census blocks (TIGER/Line tabblock20) with P.L. 94-171 total population (P1_001N) and voting-age population (P3_001N, ut2020.pl). Each block's internal point (point on surface) is assigned to a precinct of each vintage and to each congressional plan; weight(source s -> target t) = VAP(s and t) / VAP(s). Precincts with no VAP fall back to total population, then to equal split.
crosswalks.unmatched_votes: Votes in reported precincts that could not be matched to geometry are spread over the county's uncovered blocks by VAP when building district baselines
